confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain and are bounded to a typical July range. USD values assume an approximate EUR/USD rate of about 1.15 that was not sourced from a search.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a mid-sized French regional city with a large student population, moderate tourism, and somewhat lower prices than Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux, or Nice. Closest comparables are mid-sized French cities such as Montpellier and Nantes. Cocktail and wine anchors were set by applying a typical French bar and restaurant price ratio to the beer anchor, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
